::: {#exm-in-context-learning}

#### A few-shot prompt

Here is a prompt in the few-shot format of @brown2020language [figure 2.1]:

```text
Translate English to French:
cat => chat
house => maison
water => eau
bread =>
```

@brown2020language call a prompt with no examples zero-shot,
one with one example one-shot,
and one with a few examples few-shot,
so the three translated examples make this prompt few-shot [in-context learning](#def-in-context-learning).
The model's continuation after the last arrow is its answer.
The English and French words here are ours, not Brown and colleagues'.

:::
